📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 ret：close / close.shift(5) - 1
  2. 计算 range_：high - low
  3. 计算 range_med：range_.rolling(window=20, min_periods=20).median()
  4. 计算 range_mad：(range_ - range_med).abs().rolling(window=20, min_periods=20).mean()
  5. 计算 range_z：(range_ - range_med) / range_mad
  6. 计算 raw：ret * range_z * vol_ratio
  7. 计算 factor：talib.EMA(raw, timeperiod=10)
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

"kw">class="kw">def factor_lag_vol_robust_volratio(df): df_copy = df.copy() ret = df_copy["str">'close'] / df_copy["str">'close'].shift(5) - 1 range_ = df_copy["str">'high'] - df_copy["str">'low'] range_med = range_.rolling(window=20, min_periods=20).median() range_mad = (range_ - range_med).abs().rolling(window=20, min_periods=20).mean() range_z = (range_ - range_med) / range_mad.replace(0.0, np.nan) _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["str">'volume'], window=20) raw = ret * range_z * vol_ratio factor = talib.EMA(raw, timeperiod=10) df_copy["str">'factor_lag_vol_robust_volratio'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_lag_vol_robust_volratio']
